task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, you could, like, move east. That done, venture south. After that, lift the passkey from the floor of the spare room. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
You've just sauntered into a bedroom. You begin to take stock of what's in the room.



There is an open passageway leading east. There is an open hatch leading west. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unguarded.

thought: I should move east as instructed.
feedback:
